scope: Technical proposal audit; final report and presentation deferred. No original proposal promises rewritten.

items.commitment: Dataset acquisition, preprocessing and existing overall labels
items.note: Cleaned test contains 1085 pairs; original support labels preserved.

items.commitment: NLI and whole-claim LLM baselines; overall accuracy, precision, recall and F1
items.note: Six saved test reports evaluated on identical IDs and dataset fingerprints, with failures retained.

items.commitment: Claim decomposition, evidence alignment, component labels and overall aggregation
items.note: Retrieved passages are model inputs, not independently verified evidence. Whole-claim fallback cannot provide localized judgments.

items.commitment: Manual component annotation and localization evaluation
items.note: Original 15 claims / 35 details; AI-assisted annotations and output exposure. Reference-aligned error detection and separate prediction-unit audit; not comprehensive span precision.
All 21 selected details in 10 additional cases user-confirmed after assisted review. Category coverage achieved; purposive, small, overlapping counts do not establish a general ranking of difficulty.
Targeted category supplement is purposive rather than representative stratified sampling. Keep it separate from the original subset; no population-level claims.

items.commitment: Examples not used during development / held-out final evaluation
items.note: Earlier test errors informed subsequent development. Existing test results cannot be made untouched retrospectively. Generalization would need a genuinely unexposed dataset and frozen methods.

items.commitment: Compare fine-grained method with conventional classification
items.note: 7B before verification has highest macro-F1 but lower accuracy than majority. 3B/7B comparison confounds model size. Saved before/after comparison is not an independent rerun.
19 automated tests; three live synthetic CLI demonstrations passed. Saved analysis reproduced in fresh extraction using existing environment, not a fresh dependency installation.
Proposal explicitly describes these as conditional extensions. Neither is required to complete the implemented core scope.
Working CLI provides claim/source input and component output. Frontend is an optional presentation improvement.
Final documentation remains for the end as requested; this audit does not claim the entire proposal is fully satisfied.

conclusion: Core implementation and exploratory evaluation completed, with explicit methodological departures. Do not describe held-out independence or general category-difficulty ranking as achieved.
